name: Colombo & West Coast
description: The commercial capital and the beach towns south of it. Most travellers arrive here via Bandaranaike International Airport.

name: South Coast
description: Golden beaches, the Dutch-era Galle Fort, whale watching from Mirissa and the national parks of the deep south.

name: Cultural Triangle
description: The dry-zone heartland of ancient Sri Lanka: Sigiriya, Dambulla, Polonnaruwa and Anuradhapura, plus elephant gatherings at Minneriya.

name: Hill Country
description: Cool highlands of tea estates, waterfalls and misty peaks, including Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Ella. Famous for its scenic train rides.

name: East Coast
description: Calm turquoise bays and surf breaks that are at their best when the south-west is rainy: Trincomalee, Pasikudah and Arugam Bay.

name: Jaffna & the North
description: Tamil culture, Hindu kovils, islands and distinctive cuisine. Less visited and very rewarding.
